MEMIF_ JOB_ PENDING: The last job is waiting for execution or currently being executed. MEMIF_ JOB_ CANCELED: The last job has been canceled (which means it failed). MEMIF_ BLOCK_ INVALID: The requested block has been invalidated, the requested operation can not be performed. Description Service to return the Job Result. Available via Ea.h
